source_evidence: Depending on the plan, you may be able to automate your purchases and have the cost deducted automatically from your savings account.
answer: Some direct stock plans let you automate stock purchases, with the cost deducted automatically from your savings account. The plan generally buys shares at set times—such as daily, weekly, or monthly—and at an average market price, rather than letting you choose a specific purchase time or market price. Check the plan’s rules to understand how it works and whether it has fees or other requirements.
